name: Formalize key-rate (partial) duration and the sum = effective-duration identity
description: Key-rate duration of a multi-tenor bond via HasDerivAt on a single tenor's spot rate, and the identity that key-rate durations sum to the parallel-shift effective duration.

import MathFin.FixedIncome.KeyRateDuration

open MathFin

/-- Key-rate duration of a multi-tenor bond via HasDerivAt on a single tenor's spot rate, and the identity that key-rate durations sum to the parallel-shift effective duration. -/
theorem mf_fixedincome_key_rate_duration {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (T c r : ι → ℝ) (k : ι) (hk : k ∈ s) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => P s T c (Function.update r k x))
        (-(c k * T k * zcb (r k) 0 (T k))) (r k) ∧
    HasDerivAt (fun h => P s T c (fun i => r i + h))
        (-(∑ j ∈ s, c j * T j * zcb (r j) 0 (T j))) 0 ∧
    ∑ j ∈ s, KRD s T c r j = ED s T c r :=
  MathFin.hasDerivAt_P_singleTenor_and_parallelShift_and_krd_sum_eq_ed s T c r k hk
